rules.description: Every fact has a valid entity_id (joins to entity_mappings)
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base.financial_facts WHERE entity_id IS NULL OR entity_id = ''
rules.rationale: Facts without entity resolution are orphans — every fact must trace to a canonical entity

rules.sql: SELECT fact_id, COUNT(*) FROM base.financial_facts GROUP BY fact_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
rules.rationale: fact_id is a deterministic hash of the grain (cik, concept, unit, start_date, end_date, accession_number) — duplicates indicate a join or hash bug

rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base.financial_facts WHERE is_superseded = true AND superseded_by IS NULL
rules.rationale: Superseded facts must point to the filing that superseded them for audit traceability

rules.description: Fiscal calendar covers all (entity, fiscal_year, fiscal_period) combinations in facts
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.cik || '-' || f.fiscal_year || '-' || f.fiscal_period) - COUNT(DISTINCT c.cik || '-' || c.fiscal_year || '-' || c.fiscal_period) FROM base.financial_facts f LEFT JOIN base.fiscal_calendar c ON f.cik = c.cik AND f.fiscal_year = c.fiscal_year AND f.fiscal_period = c.fiscal_period
rules.rationale: Every (entity, year, period) in facts should have a corresponding fiscal calendar entry for temporal alignment

rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base.financial_facts WHERE calendar_quarter < 1 OR calendar_quarter > 4
rules.rationale: Calendar quarter must be a valid quarter number

rules.description: Amendment tracking entries reference valid accession_numbers
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base.amendment_tracking a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM base.financial_facts f WHERE f.accession_number = a.original_accession) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM base.financial_facts f WHERE f.accession_number = a.amendment_accession)
rules.rationale: Every amendment tracking entry must reference real filings in financial_facts

rules.description: No orphan facts (every cik has entity_mapping)
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.cik) FROM base.financial_facts f WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM base.entity_mappings e WHERE e.cik = f.cik)
rules.rationale: The model join filters out unknown CIKs, so any fact in the table must have a corresponding entity mapping
